get.summary: Read the indicators and KPI sets as RDF (Turtle)
get.description:
The indicators and KPI sets as RDF (Turtle) following RIMO 0.2.0: each indicator is a `rimo:KPI` with its name, description, example, `rimo:isQualitativeIndicator`, one `rimo:KPIValue` node that carries the unit, `rimo:measuredBy` and `rimo:canBeAutomatedBy`, and `rimo:mandatoryFor`, `rimo:recommendedFor` or `rimo:appliedTo` pointing to the KPI set (a RIMO service category when the set maps to one). Definitions only: no measurement and no service. The identifiers identify; they are not addresses of pages. `Cache-Control: private, no-cache`. The same document without a token is `GET /public/kpi/rimo.ttl` and `/public/kpi/rimo.jsonld` of the internal surface.

Needs the scope `kpi.framework.v1.read`.

get.summary: List the measurements of a service
get.description:
The values reported for one service, one row per indicator and month. `service` is required (the id or the abbreviation of a service; a request for every service is an export, not this list). `indicators` keeps the named indicators (names without case, or ids), `start` and `stop` keep the months from and up to the given one (`YYYY-MM` or `YYYY-MM-DD`; any day of a month means that month). An unknown service or indicator, a bad `start` or `stop`, an unknown parameter and a `start` after `stop` are 422 naming the parameter. Sorted by month, then by indicator name without case, then by id, so the order holds across pages; pages count from 0 and `pageSize` is at most 100 (default 100). `totalCount` is the size of the filtered set. A value of an indicator the service no longer reports is still listed. The list is `result`, not the legacy `data`.

Needs the scope `kpi.ingestion.v1.read`.

post.summary: Record the measurements of a service
post.description:
Upserts a batch of 1 to 500 values for one service: a month that already has a value for that indicator is updated, never duplicated. The batch is all or nothing: one bad item is a 422 that names every bad path (`[3].kpi`, `[3].value`, `[3].date`) and nothing is stored. Only the KPIs the service has (its KPI set and its extra indicators) are accepted, a value must fit the type and the bounds of its indicator, a month after the current one is refused, and the same indicator and month twice in one batch is refused. `service` is the id or the abbreviation of a service; an unknown one is 422 naming `service`. The token needs two scopes, `kpi.ingestion.v1.write` (this route) and `kpi.ingestion.measurement.submit` (the permission the service checks), and its owner must be allowed to submit for that service (an approved member of its provider, or an Admin): else 403. A body over 3 MiB is 413. Structural errors of the JSON (a missing field, a wrong type) are named by their position, `0.kpi`.

Needs the scope `kpi.ingestion.v1.write`.

parameters.description: Required. The id or the abbreviation of a service.
parameters.name: service

kpi.description: The name of an indicator of the service (without case), or its id.

value.description: What the value type of the indicator accepts: a number, or text (a duration as `HH-MM-SS`, a percentage as a number from 0 to 100).

date.description: The month: `YYYY-MM`, or any day `YYYY-MM-DD` of it. It is stored as the last day of the month. Not after the current month.

inserted.description: Values stored for a month that had none.

updated.description: Values that replaced a different one.

unchanged.description: Values that were the same as the stored one: not written.

409.description: An indicator was deleted while the batch was written; nothing was recorded, try again.

413.description: The body is larger than 3 MiB.
